selection_policy.rule: Rank non-healthy collectors by confirmed goal gap, portfolio leverage, expected rubric impact, evidence state, readiness and stall risk. Healthy collectors remain monitoring-only.

selected_actions.big_goal: A safe multi-project command and approval bridge with explicit human approval, correct routing, complete delivery evidence, and low retry cost.
selected_actions.action: Rebuild the Prompt Router and independent Code Copilot path from current main, then prove one approved end-to-end production delivery.
selected_actions.success_contract: Fresh-main PR, green current suite, preview proof and submit-to-visible-result delivery evidence are complete.
selected_actions.missing_proof: Fresh-main implementation, current CI and live bridge delivery.
selected_actions.next_quality_threshold: Rebase the stacked approval chain, obtain a fully green suite, and prove one approved proposal to Codex command to delivery result.

selected_actions.big_goal: A live and trustworthy command and observability surface showing current portfolio health, strategic progress, Daily Intelligence, and exact source-to-deploy evidence.
selected_actions.action: Verify the current public dashboard timestamp, source commit, content deploy, immutable receipt and visible strategic scoreboards as one exact snapshot.
selected_actions.success_contract: Emit live_verified evidence only when timestamp, source, receipt, deploy and visible-surface equality are all proven.
selected_actions.missing_proof: Post-merge content deploy, immutable matching receipt and independent public timestamp/UI verification.
selected_actions.next_quality_threshold: Prove one watchdog-triggered recovery with a matching public timestamp, source commit, content deploy, receipt and visible scoreboards.

selected_actions.big_goal: A coherent and trustworthy Reiki training and practitioner platform with excellent live journeys, safe administration, and measured inquiries or bookings.
selected_actions.action: Run a complete product, live and conversion audit and establish the first bounded inquiry or booking metric.
selected_actions.success_contract: Current journey evidence and one named KPI with owner, unit and measurement window are persisted.
selected_actions.missing_proof: Current production journey and inquiry or booking measurement source.
selected_actions.next_quality_threshold: Run one full product, live and conversion audit and establish the first observed inquiry or booking KPI.

blocked_actions.big_goal: A trusted bilingual esoteric-commerce platform with complete catalog parity, excellent mobile discovery, secure owner administration, durable orders and uploads, and measured conversion.
blocked_actions.action: Prove Google owner login, server allowlist, durable admin change or upload, public visibility and order handoff in production.
blocked_actions.success_contract: Owner and non-owner auth matrix plus fresh-session persistence and customer-visible outcome are proven without exposing credentials.
blocked_actions.missing_proof: Authenticated owner access and production Google provider evidence.
blocked_actions.next_quality_threshold: Prove one production owner journey: Google login to admin change or upload to public visibility to order handoff.

blocked_actions.big_goal: A trustworthy owner-only financial control system with reconciled history, current provider balances, explainable movements, secure sessions, and zero synthetic accounting.
blocked_actions.action: Prove signed owner production identity, migration parity and timestamped current provider balances in one reconciliation run.
blocked_actions.success_contract: Historical totals, current balances and zero synthetic adjustments are independently reported with bounded timestamps.
blocked_actions.missing_proof: Authorized origin, owner session and provider-balance access.
blocked_actions.next_quality_threshold: Prove a production owner session and reconcile imported totals plus current provider balances in one evidence run.

blocked_actions.big_goal: A polished therapeutic self-analysis product with a coherent workbook, secure production identity, durable progress, safe boundaries, and clear paid-support pathways.
blocked_actions.action: Complete a reversible Firebase preview cutover proving login, durable saved progress, logout and restoration before production.
blocked_actions.success_contract: Provider, domain and environment readiness plus authenticated preview journey and rollback are proven.
blocked_actions.missing_proof: Firebase project, provider, authorized-domain and environment access.
blocked_actions.next_quality_threshold: Complete a reversible Firebase preview cutover proving login, saved progress and the core intake journey before production.

blocked_actions.big_goal: A clearly governed legacy production platform whose source, live build, data and auth state, and retirement or coexistence role are explicitly proven.
blocked_actions.action: Prove canonical source and live state, then choose coexistence, bounded migration, read-only archive or retirement.
blocked_actions.success_contract: Owner-confirmed role, data-preservation plan, source-to-live mapping and rollback are recorded.
blocked_actions.missing_proof: Canonical source mapping and owner governance decision.
blocked_actions.next_quality_threshold: Prove the canonical live source and decide coexistence, migration, or retirement with preservation and rollback evidence.

collector_health.big_goal: A premium and concise event-program ecosystem with excellent mobile experience, reliable publishing, clear safety and trust, and measured conversion of qualified Toronto interest.
collector_health.action: Instrument qualified interest to conversation to confirmed registration across active Toronto programs.
collector_health.success_contract: A privacy-safe aggregate funnel has metric names, units, bounded windows, owner and weekly cadence.
collector_health.missing_proof: Observed registration source and agreed privacy-safe aggregation path.
collector_health.next_quality_threshold: Instrument qualified interest to conversation to confirmed registration across the three programs.

collector_health.action: Choose retained reference, bounded migration source or read-only retirement and document parity plus rollback.
collector_health.success_contract: One owner-confirmed transition state with preservation boundaries, acceptance evidence and rollback.
collector_health.next_quality_threshold: Choose and document retained reference, migration source, or retired archive, with parity and rollback evidence.

collector_health.big_goal: Consistently choose the highest-leverage work, execute safe improvements end-to-end, learn from failures, reduce rework, and prove live outcomes without false success.
collector_health.action: Register one privacy-safe business outcome source and cadence for every commercial active project.
collector_health.success_contract: Commercial projects expose aggregate outcome names, owners, units and bounded windows without personal or financial payloads.
collector_health.missing_proof: Observed KPI adapters for commercial projects.
collector_health.next_quality_threshold: Calibrate priority weights against completed outcomes and measured time-to-proof without changing rubrics opportunistically.

collector_health.success_contract: Privacy-safe aggregate counters have definitions, units, bounded windows and a daily cadence.
collector_health.missing_proof: Stable non-content retry and cycle-time counter source.

collector_health.big_goal: A self-improving portfolio operating system that preserves strategic goals, selects highest-leverage work, validates delivery, learns from failures, and maintains truthful evidence.
collector_health.action: Validate collector ownership, cadence, coverage, freshness and action selection on every strategic run.
collector_health.success_contract: Every active project and System Intelligence has a valid collector and exactly three non-healthy actions are selected deterministically.
collector_health.missing_proof: Merged implementation and mandatory CI evidence.
collector_health.next_quality_threshold: Execute the selected collectors and turn exact public, provider and business observations into validated source evidence.
